filesystem.description: File system access for managing project files, data, models, notebooks, and configuration files. Enables reading, writing, and organizing ML artifacts across the entire project directory.

git.description: Git version control integration for tracking model experiments, managing code branches, collaborating on ML projects, and maintaining reproducible workflows.

brave-search.description: Web search capability for finding latest research papers, documentation, tutorials, best practices, and troubleshooting solutions for TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, LightGBM, and other ML frameworks.

fetch.description: HTTP client for retrieving real-time documentation from TensorFlow.org, PyTorch.org, scikit-learn.org, XGBoost docs, API references, and fetching data from external sources.

puppeteer.description: Web scraping and automation for extracting research papers from arXiv, documentation from dynamic websites, monitoring ML conference proceedings, and collecting market data for trading models.

github.description: GitHub integration for accessing framework repositories (tensorflow/tensorflow, pytorch/pytorch, dmlc/xgboost), exploring code examples, managing model releases, and collaborating with the ML community.

memory.description: Persistent memory storage for maintaining experiment results, model metadata, training configurations, hyperparameter tuning history, and contextual information across ML workflows.

sequential-thinking.description: Reasoning engine for complex ML problem-solving, architectural decisions, debugging model issues, designing experiments, and systematic analysis of trading strategies.

e2b-code-interpreter.description: Isolated Python code execution environment for safe data analysis, model training, feature engineering, statistical testing, and running ML experiments without affecting the local environment.

postgres.description: Structured database integration for storing experiment metadata, model performance metrics, trading signals, backtest results, and enabling advanced analytics queries.
